seo.meta_title: 151 Coffee Secret Menu: Drinks and What's in Them
seo.meta_description: 151 Coffee's secret menu drinks include the S'mores, Birthday Cake Latte, German Chocolate and Grasshopper. What's in each one and how to order it.

question: What's on the 151 Coffee Secret Menu?
quick_answer: 151 Coffee's secret menu is a set of off-menu espresso drinks made by combining the chain's regular syrups. Well-known ones include the S'mores (dark chocolate, brown sugar cinnamon and toasted marshmallow), the Birthday Cake Latte (white chocolate and Almond Roca), the German Chocolate (coconut and caramel with chocolate milk) and the Grasshopper (crème de menthe and chocolate). Since they aren't on the board, order by listing the flavors if your barista doesn't know the name.
key_facts: S'mores: dark chocolate, brown sugar cinnamon, toasted marshmallow
Birthday Cake Latte: white chocolate, Almond Roca
German Chocolate: coconut, caramel, chocolate milk
Order by flavors if the name isn't recognized

body.heading: How 151's secret menu works
body.text: 151 Coffee, a Texas drive-thru chain, has a large lineup of syrups and milks, so baristas can mix many drinks that aren't printed on the menu board. The secret menu drinks below come from fan and staff lists shared online, and each one is built with espresso plus two or three regular flavors. Availability can vary by store, so naming the flavors is the surest way to order.

body.heading: Dessert-style lattes
body.text: The S'mores combines dark chocolate, brown sugar cinnamon and toasted marshmallow syrups with espresso and whole milk. The Birthday Cake Latte mixes white chocolate and Almond Roca with espresso and breve (half-and-half). The French Toast pairs white chocolate with brown sugar cinnamon, and the West Coast mixes white chocolate and salted caramel, both made with breve.

body.heading: Chocolate and coconut drinks
body.text: The German Chocolate mixes coconut and caramel with espresso and chocolate milk. The Bob Marley uses coconut and banana with chocolate milk. The Double Chocolate Macchiato layers vanilla, espresso and chocolate milk with a chocolate drizzle, and the Grasshopper adds crème de menthe and chocolate sauce for a mint-chocolate latte.

body.heading: Nutty and creamy picks
body.text: The Almond Bar combines white chocolate and almond syrups with espresso and whole milk. The White Russian, despite the name, has no alcohol: it's white chocolate and Irish cream syrup with espresso and breve, similar to 151's popular Irish Sin.

body.heading: Ordering tips
body.text: These recipes are usually listed as hot drinks, but you can ask for most of them iced. Ask for the drink by name first, then list the flavors if needed. Prices follow 151's regular specialty latte pricing for your size. See our 151 Coffee menu page for prices.

faqs.q: Does 151 Coffee have a secret menu?
faqs.a: Yes, an unofficial one. It's made up of drinks that combine 151's regular syrups.

faqs.q: What is in the 151 Birthday Cake Latte?

faqs.q: Does the 151 White Russian have alcohol?
faqs.a: No. It's white chocolate and Irish cream syrups with espresso and breve.
